findings.summary: The proposed fix for unguarded async route handlers does not address the root cause of unhandled rejections.
findings.scenario: If an unhandled rejection occurs in any of the specified routes, it will still crash the Node.js process because no error middleware or `process.on('unhandledRejection')` is registered. The proposed solution only adds a helper function to log and respond with HTTP status codes but does not prevent the process from crashing.

critique.reason: The diff does not register any error middleware or `process.on('unhandledRejection')`, so unhandled rejections will still crash the Node.js process.
